h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khandwa

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khandwa

items.pText: Khandwa is the main town of the Nimar region in western Madhya Pradesh, with Omkareshwar on the Narmada a short drive away. Nimar summers are very hot, and for much of the year children here play outdoors mostly after the sun goes down. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, colonies and municipal gardens from our factory in Vasai, about 450 km away, delivered by road.

A play area used mainly in the evening has to be planned for that. Light, sightlines and seating matter more than they would on a school ground used in the morning. We look at where existing street lights and building lights fall on your site and place the equipment within their reach. Swings and spinning pieces should never sit in a dark corner, where a child running past might not see them moving.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a play area for evening use

c: Put the play area where existing lights already reach, or plan new lighting with your electrician before the layout is fixed. Keep benches facing the equipment and inside the lit area, so parents can see every child. Avoid placing a swing set or merry-go-round at the dim edge of the park. Light-coloured equipment from our roto-moulded shades is easier to see at dusk than dark tones. Roto-moulded slides and decks also cool down soon after sunset.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 450 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment be used safely after dark?
items.a: Yes, if the area is well lit and adults can see every piece. Our equipment does not include lighting, so plan it with your electrician and place the play area within the lit zone.

items.q: Which colours are easiest to see in the evening?
items.a: Lighter shades such as yellow, light blue and green stand out better at dusk than dark tones. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades to choose from.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Khandwa and the rest of Nimar by road, and install it through our own team or a dealer in Madhya Pradesh.
